runtime: Godot 4.7.2 .NET, development Debug build, Windows, headless
method: 600 samples each; first 60 excluded below. Timings in ms unless bytes/calls/count. Nested scopes overlap and must not be added. Simulation uses fixed 1/60 or 1/30 delta; world uses live headless frame delta. World runs use cached region data and 441 loaded chunks. GPU and visual stutter not measured. Other Godot editor remained open. Large uninstrumented wall-time outliers also occurred with trains stopped; their origin is unresolved.

changes: 64 m spatial buckets with conservative bounds
Cached car inverse bases and braking envelopes
Index refresh after each train moves within a substep
Allocation-free overlap axes and articulated section loops
collision_optimization.notes: Same saved snapshot and harness; first 60 of 600 samples discarded. Physics, sample spacing, curve checks, collision envelope and reservation rules unchanged. Index build/update cost included in movement, outside collision sub-scope. Full world uses variable frame deltas and can follow a different simulation timeline; fixed-delta simulation comparisons are more controlled. No multithreading added. Cold signal/JIT spikes and uninstrumented wall-time stalls are not addressed.
